target: patched test_agent backend on http://127.0.0.1:8003 against http://localhost:3001/
purpose: Continue optimizing the test platform toward release-grade automated login regression for Cangjie.

isolated_backend.reason: The primary backend on 8002 had unrelated running tasks, so a patched backend was started on an isolated port to avoid interrupting other work.

runs.finding: ConditionResult validation failed when the LLM returned trigger as an object such as {"username":"admin","password":"admin123"} instead of a string.
runs.fix: core/skills/condition_analyzer.py now normalizes LLM condition shapes before Pydantic validation.

runs.finding: The assertion derivation stage failed the whole task when any source-group batch produced no usable assertions.
runs.fix: core/skills/assertion_deriver.py now continues with partial assertion sets and records partial_fallback diagnostics instead of failing the entire task.

runs.finding: Execution clicked the quick-fill button successfully but timed out because the terminal checker did not have deterministic form-value evidence.
runs.fix: core/runtime.py adds deterministic quick-fill input-value terminal checks for explicitly quick-fill/preset-credential cases.

runs.finding: The first deterministic input-value implementation was too broad and produced a false positive for a normal login-success case by seeing only username=admin.
runs.fix: core/runtime.py now restricts deterministic input-value checks to explicit quick-fill/preset-credential cases and requires both expected username and expected password.

executed_case.title: 一键填值自动填充正确的管理员凭据
executed_case.terminal_assertion: 确定性表单值证据匹配: username=admin, password=expected credential
executed_case.evidence_scope: This proves the quick-fill form-value branch only; it does not prove successful admin login.

runs.finding: The post-tightening online run completed and the narrowed quick-fill deterministic assertion passed without the previous login-success false positive.
runs.remaining_gap: The run selected only 1 of 4 generated candidate cases. The real admin login success/API-token assertion remained deferred or manual-review scoped, so full login regression is not yet covered.

runs.finding: After restarting 8003 with the business-console fix, online selection expanded from 1 to 3 cases and no longer deferred all dashboard/login-success cases.
execution_findings: TC-c5955979b9 valid-login E2E attempted #5 but resolved to stale xpath=//input[5], then timed out.
TC-7a183c6132 direct API login case was selected into the UI runtime and failed because the runtime has no HTTP request tool.
TC-5776b88b1c login-success UI assertion clicked one-click fill instead of completing real admin login, then timed out.
fixes_after_run: core/cdp_client.py now preserves html_id, name, and aria_label from CDP DOM attributes.
core/runtime.py now resolves semantic #N elements through stable html_id/name/placeholder/label before falling back to xpath.
core/skills/auto_executability.py now defers direct API cases containing POST /, HTTP status, response body, or access_token wording.

runs.finding: After restarting with semantic-locator and API-routing fixes, all generated candidates were direct API-style cases and were correctly deferred from the UI runtime.
runs.remaining_gap: The same login regression payload can drift into API-only candidate generation, leaving no executable UI cases. The payload was tightened after this run to require UI valid-login, quick-fill, and wrong-password cases.

runs.finding: The tightened payload generated browser-UI login candidates again and selected 3 high-risk UI cases.
execution_findings: TC-42236bfefb failed without recorded form actions because terminal evaluation observed the app still on the login page.
TC-b0d32c02ed attempted input_text with value=admin instead of text=admin and was blocked by policy.missing_input_text, then timed out.
TC-9829619e9c timed out while verifying post-login navigation/session behavior.
fixes_after_run: core/runtime_action_policy.py now normalizes input_text args.value to args.text when text is absent.
evals/test_runtime_action_policy.py covers value alias acceptance and still rejects missing text/value.

runs.finding: A false positive was found: the invalid-password UI case passed without recorded input/click actions because the terminal path extractor treated http://localhost:3001/ as expected path /localhost.
fixes_after_run: core/runtime.py now ignores bare root URLs when extracting expected paths.
core/runtime.py now requires relevant input/click evidence before terminal pass for interactive cases.

runs.finding: case_generation_requirements started feeding the L2 pipeline, producing UI quick-fill, valid-login, and wrong-password candidates, but execution still timed out after partial actions.
fixes_after_run: core/task_lifecycle.py merges rules and case_generation_requirements before fact extraction and case design.

run_summaries.validated_path: quick-fill clicked and deterministic form-value assertion passed
configured login sequence filled username/password and clicked submit

runs.finding: The deterministic configured-login sequence worked, but the login-success oracle failed because the admin account is displayed as zhanghong, not literal admin.
fixes_after_run: core/runtime.py executes configured login as a deterministic username/password/submit sequence.
data/targets/cangjie/test-data.md and task payloads now record display_name=zhanghong for username admin.
core/runtime.py accepts configured account identity aliases such as display_name during terminal evaluation.

run_summaries.finding: quick-fill form-value case passed; passive mark_task_complete cases still timed out
passive login-page button existence case passed; quick-fill value case failed after LLM hand-filled username instead of clicking quick-fill

fixes_after_run: core/runtime.py now returns passed when an allowed mark_task_complete action is emitted.
core/runtime.py distinguishes passive observation cases from interactive cases before accepting completion.
core/runtime.py now clicks the one-click-fill button deterministically for quick-fill value cases.

evidence: clicked: button:has-text("一键填值体验") -> button:has-text("一键填值体验")
terminal_assertion: 确定性表单值证据匹配: username=admin, password=expected credential
terminal_assertion: Configured login succeeded: visible account identity 'zhanghong' and dashboard markers 智能体广场, 知识库管理, 技能管理 were found after submit.
runs.finding: Dashboard entry labels were exposed through interactive_elements rather than visible_texts, so the configured-login oracle was expanded to include interactive element text/label.

validated_paths: quick-fill field values: clicked 一键填值体验 and deterministic assertion matched username=admin, password=cangjie*2026
wrong-password UI rejection: filled username/password, clicked submit, stayed on login page with error evidence
valid login path remained covered in the latest lifecycle loop through configured login evidence in task 102 and direct probes
runs.finding: Full login-regression task lifecycle no longer stalls, no longer leaves pending review, and produces trustworthy terminal assertions for mandatory quick-fill and wrong-password coverage.

validated_paths: valid login: input admin/admin123, clicked submit, terminal assertion matched zhanghong plus dashboard markers
quick-fill field values: clicked 一键填值体验 and deterministic assertion matched username=admin, password=cangjie*2026
wrong-password UI rejection: input admin/cangjie*2026, clicked submit, stayed on login page with error evidence
runs.finding: Task 104 is the first same-run D4 pass covering all three mandatory login-regression paths: valid login, quick-fill field values, and wrong-password rejection.

code_changes.change: Fallback missing label[for="field-id"] selectors to [id="field-id"] controls.
Normalize LLM-generated condition scalar/list fields before validation.
Treat partial assertion batch failures as degraded diagnostics instead of task-fatal errors.
Add narrowed deterministic quick-fill form-value terminal check; unit verification passed for quick-fill and avoided the login-success false-positive branch.
Remove the bare Chinese business term 控制台 from the DevTools blocker keyword list so dashboard/login-success cases are not falsely deferred.
Preserve CDP DOM html_id, name, and aria_label attributes for stable semantic element resolution.
Resolve semantic #N selectors through stable html_id/name/placeholder/label before falling back to xpath.
Defer direct API-only cases from the UI runtime when candidate text requires POST /, HTTP status code, response body, or access_token checks.
Add regression checks proving business 控制台 remains auto-executable, 浏览器控制台 remains blocked, and direct API cases do not enter the UI runtime.
Tighten login regression requirements so online runs must generate browser-UI valid-login, quick-fill, and wrong-password cases instead of drifting to API-only cases.
Normalize input_text value to text so LLM-emitted value aliases are not blocked as missing_input_text.
Add regression checks for input_text value alias normalization and missing text/value rejection.
Normalize case_generation_requirements as text input for downstream fact extraction.
Merge rules with case_generation_requirements before the analysis pipeline.
Ignore root localhost URLs as terminal path assertions and require action evidence for interactive terminal passes.
Add deterministic configured-login action sequence and configured account identity alias terminal checks.
Accept allowed mark_task_complete actions as passed case results while rejecting completion for interactive cases without evidence.
Add deterministic one-click-fill action for quick-fill value cases and include interactive element text/label in dashboard terminal evidence.
Record that username admin is displayed as zhanghong after login.
Add regression coverage for root URL path extraction, action evidence, account aliases, mark_task_complete, configured login action, quick-fill action, and interactive dashboard labels.
Add bounded case-generation timeout with deterministic CoverageItem-to-CandidateTestCase fallback.

Promote explicit login regression requirements into high-priority UI quick-fill and wrong-password candidates, normalize API-only negative cases away from UI coverage, and keep fixture-account assertions out of unnecessary review gates.
Repair comma-separated assertion_ref values to a valid single assertion and drop unrecoverable dangling condition refs.
Add regression coverage for explicit UI wrong-password augmentation, quick-fill promotion, and fixture-account review-gate behavior.
Add regression coverage for deterministic case-generation fallback preserving trace refs and negative branches.
Add regression coverage for multi-assertion condition ref repair and unknown-ref dropping.

result.quick_reason: deterministic form value matched username and expected credential

before.deferred_reason: requires_browser_devtools caused by business 控制台 wording

remaining_risk: Direct API assertions are now deferred from UI runtime; a future API execution seam is still needed to verify status code and access_token postconditions automatically.
The task lifecycle is still slow for narrow login regression because analyzing/exploring/designing can take several minutes before execution.
The target product still has the one-click-fill password mismatch: quick-fill uses cangjie*2026 while the real local password is admin123.
